post_run_closure.limitation: The preflight copied and hashed the diagnostic entry script and hashed its test, but did not pre-snapshot every imported local dependency. Current dependency hashes can support a post-run closure only and must not be represented as a complete pre-run source closure.

gradient_evidence.scope: one fixed two-image microbatch containing one new and one replay sample; same pixels and targets for G10 and G20; not the full 22-sample update
interpretation: The approximately 93.5 percent non-head squared-gradient share is reproducible in both checkpoints on this microbatch, but the non-head group also contains 46 of 67 convolution layers and many more parameters; the share alone does not prove pathological gradient allocation.
Foreground assignment changes from 113 to 122 between checkpoints, so the lower G20 normalized loss is not a fixed-assignment improvement claim.

Both full-model gradients would be clipped. Freezing all non-head parameters would remove their contribution from clip_grad_norm_; therefore a head-only run changes both the trainable set and the effective head-gradient gain, not only which tensors optimizer.step updates.

weight_numeric_range.coverage: all 113100 convolution weight elements in each checkpoint
interpretation: Values with latent code just above 127 or below -128 can still round to a legal endpoint; only rounded_code_out_of_range measures an active hard-clamp case here. Thus the correct hard-clamp count is G10 0 and G20 3 of 113100, all in non-head layers.
The zero Torch-float32 versus NumPy-float64 code differences closes the previously identified encoding-path risk for the complete current G10 and G20 weight tensors.
gradient_over_quant_step omits learning rate, clip gain, momentum and optimizer state; it must not be interpreted as the number of quantization steps moved by an actual SGD update.

numeric_cross_evidence.four_training_frame_result: Restoring the parent values for 46 non-head layers reduced all-seven-channel normalized RMSE means from 0.300929/0.477947/0.290801 to 0.041310/0.057916/0.013152, whereas restoring only 21 head layers left them at 0.298872/0.478951/0.291124.
numeric_cross_evidence.joint_interpretation: The independent four-frame activation localization and two-sample backward norm share both point to the non-head path as the highest-value controlled experimental target. Neither is AP causality, and the native runtime root cause remains UNRESOLVED.

proposed_head_only_experiment_review.technical_assessment: Reasonable as one bounded branch experiment, but it is not a pure one-variable attribution because excluding non-head gradients also changes global clipping and increases the effective head-gradient gain relative to the original full-model update.
minimum_contract_if_approved: start from the preserved G10 checkpoint hash, not G20
freeze all 46 non-head convolution weight and bias tensors before constructing the optimizer and assert they never enter optimizer state
migrate only the matching G10 head momentum buffers by stable parameter name and shape rather than raw optimizer parameter IDs
use exactly the original continuation samples for global updates 11 through 15, microbatch 2, total 22, SGD learning rate 1e-4, unchanged scales and loss normalization
record the changed clipping semantics explicitly in the new protocol
use a new output and run identity, execute resume/GPU/export gates, cap at five updates, evaluate same17 once, and do not auto-continue

decision: The completed numeric and gradient diagnostics are internally consistent and justify proposing a bounded non-head-freeze control, not claiming root cause or starting it. No new training recipe or updates are authorized until the user approves.
